scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w functions && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-mstp "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-mstp --import .emulator-data --export-on-exit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w functions && node scripts/e2e.mjs mock
scripts.test:e2e:real: npm run build -w functions && node scripts/e2e.mjs real
